summary: The installed system building a program on itself with make, rebuilding only what changed, and keeping the times make orders by across a reboot

cases.behavior: The installed system, as the test account at the console, builds a program of two sources and a shared header with make and tcc, finds it up to date, rebuilds exactly what a changed source or header needs, fails without the command line's compiler and names the makefile's, cleans with a file named clean present and builds this project's cat with make; after a reboot of the same disk the object's time is the one recorded, nothing rebuilds, and a source changed after the reboot rebuilds into the new program

execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends the machine and removes the disk copy and its evidence, which it keeps after a failure

steps.does: boot a copy of the os-real disk and log in at the console as the test account
write the project in /tmp/demo, define age, build it with make CC=tcc and run the program
make with nothing changed, after a changed source, straight after the rebuild, after a touched header, without the override, and clean with a file named clean present
build /src/utils/cat.c with make and compare it with BusyBox's cat
build again, age the files, record the object's time, sync, and end the machine with QMP's quit
boot the same copy of the disk again and log in at the console as the test account
read the object's time, make with nothing changed, change a source, make, run the program, sync and end the machine

assertions.checks: the test account logs in at the console with its password on the first boot
make CC=tcc builds the program from scratch with status 0
the program prints ANSWER 42
a make with nothing changed exits 0, runs no tcc and reports the program up to date
after lib.c changes, make exits 0, compiles lib.c once and main.c never, and links the program once
the relinked program prints ANSWER 63
a make straight after that rebuild exits 0, runs no tcc and reports the program up to date
after demo.h is touched, make exits 0 and compiles both lib.c and main.c
a make without CC on the command line, whose makefile names a compiler that does not exist, exits with a status other than 0
that make names /no/such/compiler in what it printed
make clean with a file named clean present exits 0 and leaves neither prog nor main.o
make CC=tcc builds this project's cat from /src/utils/cat.c with status 0
the cat make built writes the same bytes as BusyBox's cat, which cmp in the guest judges
the object's recorded modification time is a number other than 0
sync returns and the shell comes back at the end of the first boot
the test account logs in at the console with its password after the reboot
after the reboot, the object's modification time is the one recorded before it
a make after the reboot with nothing touched exits 0 and runs no tcc
after lib.c changes after the reboot, make exits 0 and compiles lib.c once
the program rebuilt after the reboot prints ANSWER 84
sync returns and the shell comes back at the end of the second boot

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended

native.reason: the case reboots the installed system's disk and judges the times the file system kept and the clock across the reboot
